learner_starting_state: Can run, edit, and debug a small Python file but has not yet manipulated nested structured data.
learner_ending_state: Can distinguish lists from dictionaries, navigate nested values, append a record, update a nested field, and parse and serialize JSON.
mastery_gate: Pass primary and fresh-transfer programs at 8 of 8 each, predict four nested accesses, and explain the list-dictionary-JSON relationship without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: The AI-901 Python prerequisite traces to the official study guide; all examples, packets, gates, and Terminal framing are course-authored bridge instruction.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Do not present Python dictionary syntax as identical to JSON text; verify runtime/library versions before live integration.

notes: Offline two-form structured-data bridge with deterministic and anti-hardcoding validation.
